chapters: Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook oidha' tas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios pai' gu Ejipto bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ɨɨbhidham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx jɨ'xdha' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu Aaroon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chio'ñ bopxi'ñ maa'n mo'o gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu chio'ñ no'm bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Elisur gu mar gu Sedeur.
Jano' ba' gu Simeoon gu Selumiel gu mar gu Surisaddai.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Naasoon gu mar gu Aminadab.
Jano' ba' gu Issakâr gu Natanael gu mar gu Suar.
Jano' ba' gu Sabuloon gu Eliab gu mar gu eloon.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' gu Epraim gu Elisama gu mar gu Ammiud; mi' dhɨr gu Manasees gu Gamaliel gu mar gu Pedasur.
Jano' ba' gu Benjamiin gu Abidaan gu mar gu Gedeoon.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu Aieser gu mar gu Ammisaddai.
Jano' ba' gu Aser gu Pegiel gu mar gu Okraan.
Jano' ba' gu Gad gu Eliasap gu mar gu Deuel.
Jano' ba' gu Neptalii gu Aira gu mar gu Enaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ chiñia' bopxi'ñ tattat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees gu Aaroon dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ɨɨbhidham.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ɨɨbhidham bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen jix bɨɨx duu oo'm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ɨɨbhidham bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga mambhɨɨx gɨ' vaik.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Gad oo'm jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr mambhɨɨx maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sabuloon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon mambhɨɨx kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Epraim oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Manasees guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Manasees guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Dan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aser guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Aser oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii mambhɨɨx vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨɨx chiñia' gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mambhɨɨx.
Gu' gu' gu Lebitas cham jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan bopxi'ñ tattat.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Lebii tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Lebitas vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vaak zel xikoolh vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Lebitas guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na pai' dhuuk vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vaak zel maa'n guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn maa'n ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Gu' gu' gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ xikoolh vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix duu.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak tattat; gio ba' xikoolh vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tas buusñi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu Naasoon gu mar gu Aminadab.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr gu Natanael gu mar gu Suar.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Sabuloon gu Eliab gu mar gu eloon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Judaa chamaam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Rubeen saagi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu Elisur gu mar gu Sedeur.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oo'm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ju'ñdharan bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon gu Selumiel gu mar gu Surisaddai.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga mambhɨɨx gɨ' vaik.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Gad; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu Eliasap gu mar gu Reuel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oo'm jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Rubeen chamaam mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut yooxi' gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ chugi'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ maa'n pai' ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Epraim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tas gei'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu Elisama gu mar gu Ammiud.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu Gamaliel gu mar gu Pedasur.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Abidaan gu mar gu Gedeoon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Epraim chamaam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' chamaam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Dan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu Aieser gu mar gu Amisaddai.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bopxi'ñ gu Aser; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Aser gu Pegiel gu mar gu Okraan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii gu Aira gu mar gu Enaan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Dan chamaam mambhɨɨx kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chugi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mambhɨɨx.
Gu' gu' gu Lebitas cham jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan gu vaak tattat.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Moisees dɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu Sinaii.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu Nadab maa'nkam mar gu Abiuu gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' gu noobh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu Nadab gu Abiuu jix koko' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu tai guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii; gio ba' cham chooto'n gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Aaroon gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' gu vupui guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bopxi'ñ gu Lebii guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aaroon na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu Lebitas gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel pai' bɨx maa'nkam mar guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Lebitas.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx maa'nkam mar; gio ba' dɨr gu tanoolh tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't; jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Lebii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jiix.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p ka't jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii jix bɨɨx duu dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Libni gu Simei.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Amram tu' gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Lebii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' gu Gersoon ja'tkam vaak gu Libni gu Simei; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Gersoon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jiix guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Gersoon guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vaak zel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu taat gu Gersonitas gu Eliasap gu mar gu Lael.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan vaak zel iiñat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ju'ñdharan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu Koat ja'tkam vaak gu Amramiitika ja'tkam vaak gu Iseariitika ja'tkam vaak gu ebroniitika ja'tkam vaak gu Osieliitika; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Koatitas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jiix guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ko'kmarak jix nukadham xidhuu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Koat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu taat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Koat gu Elisapaan gu mar gu Ussiel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' meesa mɨichdhai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam xidhuu bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu jiim bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Lebitas ka't gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam namki' jix nukadham xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu Merari ja'tkam vaak gu Maaliitika ja'tkam vaak gu Musiitika; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Merari.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jiix jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Gu' gu' tu' gu u'vɨ cham ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na jix bhai' ka't namkidhat ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na pai' dhuuk gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Nasareo na ba' tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim suudai' u'va guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' jɨ'ɨɨk suudai' u'va tu' jɨ'ɨɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam suudai' u'va dɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan mo'o bɨɨx ka'm ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ka't; mi' dhɨr kiicha' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mo'o.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga muukix.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu taat tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu naan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xibhɨk tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx na pai' dhuuk vaak jodai; na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios juraa'n bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' vaak jodai guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mo'o guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mo'o; mi' dhɨr kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan jix koi guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mo'o mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mar kaneer oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' gu tanoolh dharka' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Nasareo gu tanoolh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' ɨlhdham ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios mar kaneer oidha' tas cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan ali' karneer oidha' tas cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jajar guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Nasareo guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gu vupui guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' jix bhai' aa'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu Israeel ɨɨbhidham gu vaak tattat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chiñia' bopxi'ñ mi'p bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' maa'n gu Lebitas maa'n jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' makgɨrxi gu maa'nkar maa'n gu tanoolh ka't gu Naasoon gu mar gu Aminadab bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Moisees maa'n biipibop; gio ba' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Moisees guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' gu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios bhaai'n jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bhaan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Moisees yooxi' daraa gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix buus gu jɨvɨl gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam novɨ maa'nkar gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan vaak ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt baasɨ'n gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ yooxi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gook guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam juruuñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨx gu tukaa' bɨx gu tanoolh buimgidhak guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ novɨ maa'nkar; na guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx gɨ' kavɨk; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ yooxi'.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ va'k jum duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na pai' dhuuk i'iich gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ja'tkam tu' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Na gu' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Kibrot-attaaba na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Kibrot-attaaba guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam gu aserot tu jiim gu aserot.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Mariia gu Aaroon bhaan gu Moisees kuiñcha gu u'vɨ gu Etiope ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ gu Etiope.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Moisees tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch jix kai gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Moisees ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu chichio'ñ ka't bhaan gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Mariia; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vaik vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; mi' dhɨr moor vaik.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaav guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat toov jix dhaas ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jup tɨɨt gu Aaroon gu Mariia; gio ba' moor guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨɨtki' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' cham tu duukam gu Moisees guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu chin tu ñi'ook bɨɨx tu jiim cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios choo'n ñiokda' bhaan tu duukam gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' ka't.

Jano' ba' toov jix ai'chdhix vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Mariia ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ja'p jabook; mi' dhɨr tu jiim gu Aaroon gu Mariia guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jano' bhaan no'ch uañi'ñ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham ka't jano' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix koi vook gu naan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jano'.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na gu' tu' gu taat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mai' vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Mariia ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaak ja'tkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx ka'm jum daa'ñ gu Mariia.
Jano' ba' gu Mariia ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaak ja'tkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx ka'm jum daa'ñ gu Mariia.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam gu aserot guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Kanaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' bopxi'ñ tattat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu chio'ñ maa'n gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees bhañ dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chiñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ suulhgia'; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Sammua gu mar gu Sakkur.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon gu Sapat gu mar gu urii.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Judaa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr gu Igal gu mar gu Josep.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Epraim gu Oseas gu mar gu Nun.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu Palti gu mar gu Rapu.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon gu Gaddiel gu mar gu Sodi.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Josee bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Gaddi gu mar gu Susi.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu Ammiel gu mar gu Gemalli.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Aser gu Setur gu mar gu Mikâel.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii gu Naabii gu mar gu Bapsi.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu Geuel gu mar gu Makî.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu chio'ñ gu Moisees bhañ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Oseas gu mar gu Nun jix dhaas gu Moisees gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Josuee.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' gu Kanaan tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm saagi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim; gio ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' jix bhai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' vaak zel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' cham tu'x jai'ch cham gu u'u; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'bhɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tumiiñku guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu Sin bɨɨx ka'm gu Reob baakɨk gu Emat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm saagi'ñ tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm gu ebroon; gio ba' mi'p gu Aimaan gu Sesai gu Talmai gu ma'nkam gu Anak; mi' dhɨr gu ebroon ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ va'k gu Soaan gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Eskol guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm aichdhak gook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu Naal-eskol guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' suulh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam oo'm gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan gu Kades jix maa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gui'p; gio ba' no'ch guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bii'm suudai' na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu i'bhɨ.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jix kavɨk jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix kavɨk; gio ba' gio guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Anak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu eteo gu Jebuseo gu Amorreo guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Kananeo guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jordaan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Kaleb jix duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Gu' gu' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx gui'p; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk no'ch.

Jano' ba' jix duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bham; gio ba' gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' tu jiim pai' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ jix gɨ' dhi'; jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Anak guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' jɨɨ'ñdhat no'ch chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix maa jiiñak; gio ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu Moisees bhaan gu Aaroon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix aa' bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook vaak jodai gu oidha' gu Ejipto; jano' ba' dhi' oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook vaak jodai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu oidha' na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tutkɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji maa'n; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon ia'rɨ bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' tu jiim gu oidha' jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn no'ch guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi' gu oidha' kapbhai'; gio ba' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bii'm suudai' na jix bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu jiim bɨɨx gu jodai; gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ buimɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tattat; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi' tu'x na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan tu jiim jix duu gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ja'tkam mii' dhɨr no'x guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan tu jiim jix duu gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gui'x guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix duu gui'x guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk kua'da' jugi gu takarui' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu maa'nkar; gio ba' na ja'p gu maa'nkar ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Moisees dɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' ka't tu' uañi'ñ ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'nkar tai bhaan tu jiim jix duu gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga; gio ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na gu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ maa'nkar na jix maa gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ja'tkam mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios chiiw oidha' tas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Na pai' dhuuk jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios uañi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga gui'x na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' tu' na cham jir bhai' ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' kua' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu u'u gu tanoolh juanda'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu u'u aichdhak gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas kuupa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx gu jodai bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mai' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mai' yooxi' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx gu jodai jix koi; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Na pai' dhuuk tu duu tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ gu vupui guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Na ba' na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Koree gu mar gu Isar gu mar gu Koat gu mar gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Dataan gu Abiram gu ma'nkam gu Eliab; mi' dhɨr gu on gu mar gu Pelet gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix búup bhaan gu Moisees bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel chiñia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon gui'p; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na gu' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx jɨɨgi'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Moisees guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu vupui.

Ba' jix aa' gu Koree bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bham; gio ba' gu xibh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Koree bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu tai guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu xibh; gio ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ka't jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Moisees gu Koree; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' tu duu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Lebii bɨndak; na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gio jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Aaroon guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' bhaan vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Dataan gu Abiram gu ma'nkam gu Eliab; gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bii'm suudai' na jix bhai' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ koi oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gio tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios no'ch guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu oidha' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bii'm suudai' na jix bhai' tu' jix maa dɨppɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vupui dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees bhaam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ buur guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Moisees gu Koree; gio ba' tu' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu xibh vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Aaroon.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn maa'n vaak na jix bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios maa'n vaak na jix bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr tu' gio gu Aaroon maa'n bɨɨx vaak na jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n vaak na jix bhaan jix dhaas gu tai guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix dhaas ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨɨx gu Moisees gu Aaroon.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Koree ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bɨx gu chuukug cham gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu abla guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaak zel gu Koree gu Dataan gu Abiram.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix búup ka't gu Dataan gu Abiram; gio ba' daraa gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jano' vaak zel dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu chichio'ñ cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vaak zel gu Koree gu Dataan gu Abiram guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' gu Dataan gu Abiram moor jix dhaas kiki'ñgob vaak zel bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' tu'x; na cham gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' tu' na ja'p nu'aidha' bɨx gu chichio'ñ vaak jodai suulhgia' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham bhañ.

Gu' gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chin guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ko'iix jix dhaam suudai' jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't a'gidhimɨk ñiokda' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' ka't bɨtaa'n.
Jano' ba' jix kupi'ook gu oidha' gu chin guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Koree bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ko'iix jix dhaam suudai' jix bhaan dhaas gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel mi'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jiboi'ññor guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na gu' am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gio gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu tai gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tai; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' ja'tkam u'ua'tulhdhix bhaan gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; na gu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm nɨi'ñchudat gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' jix duu na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios cham ka't gu kai' gu Aaroon guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham ka't na ja'p gu Koree na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' bhaan jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix koi gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jum daa'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon tu jiim bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm toov ka't jix bhaan dhaas jix ñi'ñ gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees gu Aaroon vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaak na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' jootom guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' i'iich tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' kua'da'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Aaroon vaak na jix bhaan na ja'p gu Moisees dai'bus tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't kua'da' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ koko'kam ko'iix; gio ba' jix utu'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' jix koko' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham koko'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Koree.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Aaroon gu Moisees ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat bɨx chiñia' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu jurtu'nka' gu vaak tattat; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'n bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Aaroon bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Lebii; na gu' mo'o ja'tkam vaak tattat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan chuut pai' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx vaak jodai bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx chiñia' jix maa jix duu; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Aaroon ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix dhaas jix duu vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh buimgidhak suudai' u'va gu Moisees vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Aaroon gu vaak gu Lebii ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios baas guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Aaroon vupui bhaan chuut na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm nɨi'ñchudat gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na gu' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan tu' na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees; gio ba' na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios jix duu.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Moisees bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch gu'ch koko'kam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu'ch bɨx no'ch gu'ch guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' no'x guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi bɨx.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu taat bɨndak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios uañi'ñ xidhuu; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios uañi'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gio bopxi'ñ gu Lebii bopxi'ñ gu taat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' jum daa'ñ bɨndak guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; na gu' gu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jɨɨgi'ñdham tu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨndak guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' gui'x jix nukadham xidhuu jix nukadham jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Gu' gu' tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' tu' jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu Miren tu' jix maa gio jix nukadham maa'nkar na jix maa; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu maa'nkar tu'x guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu tai; gio ba' bɨx gu maa'nkar bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam abhaar na ba' tu' na ba' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' xidhuu jugi; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn abhaar ka't na ba' tu'.
