Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Moisees tu ñi'ook bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook no'ch guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix koi na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios dhi' oidha' jix gaki na ba' vaak jodai no'ch guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaakax.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Ejipto na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' cham bhai' pai' cham pai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu suudai' na ba' i'i.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Moisees gu Aaroon vupui bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' gu Aaroon xibhɨk tu ñi'ook jodai kavɨk gu vupui; gio ba' maa'n gu suudai' jix buusñi gu suudai' jodai kavɨk maa'n i'i guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix.

Ba' jix aa' jum daa'ñ gu Moisees gu Aaroon guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan jodai kavɨk; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu suudai' dhi' jodai kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Moisees gu novɨ tu' naaka'n jodai kavɨk bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gook mui'kim; gio ba' moor mumua'da' gu suudai' jix i'i guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaakax.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vupui gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu oidha' jix maa.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan duu.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom dɨr gu Kades; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Israeel xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx tu jiim tu' tɨbiap.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Ejipto guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Ejipto tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Egipkios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat.

Jano' ba' duuñ gu Jawatan Dios jix kai guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook bhañ nobii'ñ jix buusñi gu Ejipto; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' gu Kades kiicham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' u'va tu' i'i gu suudai' pai' suudai'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ kɨɨ'n tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ pai'.
Jano' ba' gu Edom jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt bia'kat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu suudai' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ u'uuk; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr jix buus gu Edom bhaan bɨɨx jix jai' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Edom guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' jix ai'chdhix gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Kades gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨɨtɨs gu kavɨk gu or.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu kavɨk gu or guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' gu Edom bham.

Jano' ba' gu Aaroon ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Aaroon gu Eleasar gu mar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu kavɨk gu or.

Jano' ba' gu vupui guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Aaroon jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Eleasar gu mar; na gu' gu Aaroon ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu kavɨk gu or gu vupui bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Aaroon jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Eleasar gu mar; gio ba' gu Aaroon jix koi guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees gu Eleasar guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Aaroon ka't jix koi jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Oyendo gu Kananeo gu gɨ'kora' gu Arad guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ saagi'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Israeel jix duu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kɨɨsa' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu Israeel do'ñcho gu Kananeo guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu orma.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu kavɨk gu or gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' gu Edom; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Ejipto na ba' vaak jodai dhi' oidha' jix gaki tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu takarui' tu' gu suudai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu i'ii'ñ juraa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' gu takarui' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ko'oi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix koi jix jai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam suudai' u'va gu Moisees gui'p; gio ba' uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam no'ch dhi' gu ko'oi; jano' ba' gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ko'oi guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka't no'x ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ii'mdagaram.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu ko'oi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ko'oi guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat oi'ñdha' tu jiim gu ko'oi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Obot.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Obot guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Ije-abarim oidha' jix gaki vupui bhaan gu Moab guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tas.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Sared.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios baasɨ'n gu Arnoon oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' gu Amorreo; na gu' gu Arnoon pai' gu Moab tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moab gu Amorreo.
Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook u'uan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Arnoon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' tu jiim gu Ar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Moab.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Beer; gio ba' dhi' oidha' suudai' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jiiñ gu Israeel dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' tu jiim gu ñi'ook oidha' suudai'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' oidha' suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam chiñia' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr oidha' jix gaki tɨɨtɨs gu Matana.
Jano' ba' gu Matana gu Naaliel; gio ba' gu Naaliel gu Bamot.
Jano' ba' gu Bamot guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vaak ja'tkam gu Moab guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Pisga guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jesimoon.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Israeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr cham i'i gu suudai' oidha' suudai'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ pai'.

Gu' gu' gu Seoon cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'; gio ba' va'k jum daa'ñ gu Seoon bɨx gu ja'tkam jix buus bhaan gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu Jaas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Israeel guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' dɨr gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Jabok bɨɨx ka'm gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; na gu' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ka't jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Amorreo gu esboon guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ taañpu'.

Na gu' na gu' gu esboon ka't kiicham gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhɨɨ'ñdham va'k bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu Arnoon.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' jix duu gu esboon guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kiicham gu Seoon.
Na gu tai jix buus gu esboon mɨmɨim kiicham gu Seoon guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Ar gu Moab gu Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Arnoon.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Moab gu Perekido gu ja'tkam gu Kêmos; gio ba' jix dhaas gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu esboon bɨɨx ka'm gu Diboon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx ka'm gu Nopa gu Medeba.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jaser; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam taañpu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Amorreo ka't.
Jano' ba' suulh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu bhóogɨt gu Basaan jix buus bhaan gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Edrei.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ɨɨbhi'ñ gu novɨ jix maa bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix duu na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu esboon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios maa'n guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vaak ja'tkam gu Moab dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor bɨx gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' gu Moab guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix jai' kuiñcha gu ja'tkam ka't jix jai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Moab kuiñcha gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moab daraa gu Madiaan; gio ba' jano' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga yooxi'; mi' dhɨr gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor ka't jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhañ jix duu gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor gu Petor ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam na ba' mɨmɨim bham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Ejipto guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vupui gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan tu'.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jano' tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' gu ja'tkam na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' jix ko'k tu jiim gu oidha'; na tu' jix duu ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu daraa gu Moab daraa gu Madiaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Balaam gui'p gu ñi'ook gu Balak.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhi' gu tukaa' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr chiñia' gu Moab guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx gu Balaam.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chio'ñ dhi' ja'tkam bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Ejipto guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vupui gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jano' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ja'tkam; na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam jix búup guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh chiñia' gu Balak; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Moab jix búup tɨɨtɨs gu Balak gui'p; gio ba' gu Balaam cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx no'ch.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Balak tɨip tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ chiñia' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Balaam gui'p; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu'.
Na gu' na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' nɨidhat jix jai' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jano' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam tu duukam gu Balak; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Balak koi gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix toja jodai jix uam jodai cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' gu tukaa' na ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu Si guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mɨmɨim gu chichio'ñ bamii' tu' bɨɨx; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix duu tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix búup guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim buur ka't bɨɨx chiñia' gu Moab.

Na gu' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gɨ' kavɨk bhaan buur bɨɨx gook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' buur jix ñi' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu kuchii guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu novɨ; gio ba' jix ai'chdhix buur gu bhóogɨt tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' naaka'n gu Balaam buur na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ buur nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tɨɨt gu Balaam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix ko'k.

Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga pai' cham ka't gu bhóogɨt na ba' tu jiim tu' kɨɨ'n tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ buur nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨtaa'n gu Balaam; gio ba' bhaam gu Balaam tu' naaka'n buur bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu chin buur gu Balaam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' vaik mui'kim.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa' buur; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu kuchii gu novɨ jano' tu' kooda'.

Ba' jix aa' buur gu Balaam; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' buur bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dɨr tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr tu jiim bɨndak jix aa'; jano' ba' cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu vupui gu Balaam jix ñi' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu bhóogɨt ga'ra' gu kuchii guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu novɨ; gio ba' gu Balaam jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan gu vupui.

Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buur dhi' vaik mui'kim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na gu' gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' buur tu' buupui guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan tu' dhi' vaik mui'kim; gio ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' gio jano' tu' kooda' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balaam nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' uañi'ñ cham bhai'x tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vupui bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt; gu' jano' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chichio'ñ; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; jano' ba' gu Balaam ka't bɨɨx chiñia' gu Balak.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Balak gu Balaam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix buus jix duu kiicham gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Arnoon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak gu Balaam; gio ba' cham tu jiim tu' mɨmɨim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham tɨbiap tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' nɨidhat.

Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa' gu Balak; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' tɨbiap tu'; gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jano' ñiokda' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chin guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Balaam bɨɨx gu Balak tɨɨtɨs kiicham gu usot.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Balak kooda' gu vaakax kakneer bhañ gu Balaam chiñia' mi'p bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Balak jix bhɨɨ gu Balaam tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Baal dɨr jix ñi' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kɨɨv ali' vaakax kɨɨv gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak jix duu na ja'p gu Balaam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Balak gu Balaam tuur gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' jix duu; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios ɨlhdham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa no'x guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Balaam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tuur gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu chin gu Balaam; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Balak ñiokda'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨx chiñia' gu Moab.

Ba' jix aa' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' gu Aram guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Balak gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab gu kakkavɨk tas buusñi; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jakob; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.

Jano' ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam oo' gu Jakob jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baasɨ'n gu Israeel gu Muera guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga koi'm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balak gu Balaam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chin na ba' jix aa'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Balak; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam pai' dɨr tu jiim; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx; jano' ba' dɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ yooxi' gu Sopim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Pisga kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan makgɨrxi tuur gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balak; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix buus guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Balaam jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu chin; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Balak guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨɨx chiñia' gu Moab; gio ba' jix aa' gu Balak; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' gu Balak bamii' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Sippor.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu chio'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr jix aa' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim.
Jano' ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Jakob tu' buupui guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu Ejipto; gio ba' juraa'n tu' na jix kavɨk na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jakob cham cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p jano' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam na ja'p maavɨt guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p maavɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ɨ'ɨr koko'kam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balak gu Balaam; na gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' cham tu' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr no'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Balak gu Balaam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ pai'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios dɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' gu Balak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Balaam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Peor guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan gu Jesimoon.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kɨɨv ali' vaakax kɨɨv gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak jix duu na ja'p gu Balaam; gio ba' makgɨrxi tuur gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix ñi' gu Balaam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Israeel cham ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gookim tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix dhaas gu vupui bhaan oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vupui jix ñi' gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor gu chio'ñ gu vupui guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' jix kai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Omnipotente; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vupui.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaak zel gu ñi'ook gu Jakob guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ju'ñdharan gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu noobh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu suudai' gu kai' ka't mumua'da' gu suudai'; gio ba' tu jiim tu' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Agag oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu Ejipto; gio ba' juraa'n tu' na jix kavɨk na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ o'oo guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' tu jiim na ja'p maavɨt na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Benditos tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Balak bhaan gu Balaam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' tɨɨgim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' vaik mui'kim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' pai'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook tu' nɨidhat gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' gio jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Balak koi gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix toja jodai jix uam jodai tu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jano' gu ja'tkam; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam jix duu gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor gu chio'ñ gu vupui guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' jix kai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Altiisimo jix ñi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Omnipotente; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vupui.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu' cham jano'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu' cham mia'n; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Estrella gu Jakob guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Israeel jix duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Moab guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Set.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Edom ka't gio guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Seir guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kiicham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Amalek jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' gu Amalek mo'o chɨbɨɨp; gu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Kineo jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' jix kavɨk ba'bhak guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jodai kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Kineo ka't baas na pai' dhuuk gu Assur tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook chɨkka ii'mdagaram na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' aajim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Kittim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Assur guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gio gu Eber; gu' gio gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Balaam ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ pai'; gio ba' gio gu Balak ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ gu Israeel gu Sittim gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Moab.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ja'tkam makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix jugi tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam gu Baal-peor; gio ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx chiñia' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu tas; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ i'iich gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maa'n mii' dhɨr ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Baal-peor.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Madianita gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu Moisees bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel joi'ndam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix búup tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix bhɨɨ u'u kavɨk gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' ka't bhaan gu chio'ñ gu Israeel vaak zel guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu chio'ñ gu Israeel gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vook; gio ba' jix utu'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koko' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios i'iich gu ma'nkam gu Israeel baabuk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu'; gio ba' gu Miren tu' dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu kai' mi' dhɨr ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chio'ñ jix koi ka't jix koi bɨɨx gu Madianita ka't gu Simri gu mar gu Salu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Madianita muukix ka't gu Kosbi mar u'vɨ gu Sur gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu taat ja'tkam vaak gu Madiaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Madianitas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Peor guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Kosbi mar u'vɨ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Madiaan gu ja'tkam ka't muukix gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha gu Peor.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Eleasar gu mar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aaroon bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu ñi'ook bɨɨx vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen; mi' dhɨr gu anok ka't ja'tkam vaak gu anokîtas; jano' ba' gu Palluu ja'tkam vaak gu Palluitas.
Jano' ba' gu esroon ja'tkam vaak gu esronitas; gio ba' gu Karmi ja'tkam vaak gu Karmitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Rubenitas; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bɨɨx duu oo'm vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Palluu; gio ba' gu Eliab.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Eliab; gio ba' gu Nemuel gu Dataan gu Abiram; na pai' dhuuk dhi' ja'tkam gu Dataan gu Abiram jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨɨx chu'p gu Koree na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' jix kupi'ook gu chin guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Koree na pai' dhuuk mii' dhɨr chu'p jix koi na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tai guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm nɨi'ñchudat.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Koree cham jix koko'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Nemuel ja'tkam vaak gu Nemuelitas; mi' dhɨr gu Jamiin ja'tkam vaak gu Jaminitas; jano' ba' gu Jakîn ja'tkam vaak gu Jakînitas.
Jano' ba' gu Sera ja'tkam vaak gu Seraitas; gio ba' gu Sauul ja'tkam vaak gu Saulitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Simeonitas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Sepoon ja'tkam vaak gu Seponitas; mi' dhɨr gu Aggi ja'tkam vaak gu Aggitas; jano' ba' gu Suni ja'tkam vaak gu Sunitas.
Jano' ba' gu Osni ja'tkam vaak gu Osnitas; gio ba' gu Eri ja'tkam vaak gu Eritas.
Jano' ba' gu Aros ja'tkam vaak gu Aroditas; gio ba' gu Areli ja'tkam vaak gu Arelitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Gad guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Er gu Onaan; mi' dhɨr gu Er gu Onaan jix koko' gu oidha' gu Kanaan.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Sela ja'tkam vaak gu Selaitas; mi' dhɨr gu Pares ja'tkam vaak gu Paresitas; jano' ba' gu Sera ja'tkam vaak gu Seraitas.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Pares; gio ba' gu esroon ja'tkam vaak gu esronitas; mi' dhɨr gu amul ja'tkam vaak gu amulitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Tola ja'tkam vaak gu Tolaitas; mi' dhɨr gu Puaa ja'tkam vaak gu Puanitas.
Jano' ba' gu Jasub ja'tkam vaak gu Jasubitas; gio ba' gu Simron ja'tkam vaak gu Simronitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Issakâr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' vaik.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sabuloon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Sered ja'tkam vaak gu Sereditas; mi' dhɨr gu Eloon ja'tkam vaak gu Elonitas; jano' ba' gu Jalel ja'tkam vaak gu Jalelitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Sabulonitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Manasees gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Manasees; gio ba' gu Makîr ja'tkam vaak gu Makîritas; mi' dhɨr gu Makîr jix mar gu Galaad; jano' ba' gu Galaad ja'tkam vaak gu Galaaditas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Galaad; gio ba' gu Jeser ja'tkam vaak gu Jeseritas; mi' dhɨr gu elek ja'tkam vaak gu elekitas.
Jano' ba' gu Asriel ja'tkam vaak gu Asrielitas; gio ba' gu Sekêm ja'tkam vaak gu Sekêmitas.
Jano' ba' gu Semida ja'tkam vaak gu Semidaitas; gio ba' gu eper ja'tkam vaak gu eperitas.

Jano' ba' gu Salpaad gu mar gu eper cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Salpaad jix bɨɨx duu gu Maala gu Noa gu ogla gu Milka gu Tirsa.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Manasees; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Epraim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Sutala ja'tkam vaak gu Sutalaitas; mi' dhɨr gu Bekêr ja'tkam vaak gu Bekêritas; jano' ba' gu Taan ja'tkam vaak gu Taanitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Sutala; gio ba' gu eraan ja'tkam vaak gu eranitas.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Epraim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Josee guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Bela ja'tkam vaak gu Belaitas; mi' dhɨr gu Asbel ja'tkam vaak gu Asbelitas; jano' ba' gu Akîram ja'tkam vaak gu Akîramitas.
Jano' ba' gu Supam ja'tkam vaak gu Supamitas; gio ba' gu upam ja'tkam vaak gu upamitas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bela jix bɨɨx duu gu Ard gu Naamaan; gio ba' gu Ard ja'tkam vaak gu Arditas; mi' dhɨr gu Naamaan ja'tkam vaak gu Naamanitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oo'm jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Dan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Suam ja'tkam vaak gu Suamitas; mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Dan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Suamitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aser guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Imna ja'tkam vaak gu Imnaitas; mi' dhɨr gu Issui ja'tkam vaak gu Issuitas; jano' ba' gu Beria ja'tkam vaak gu Beriaitas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Beria; gio ba' gu eber ja'tkam vaak gu eberitas; mi' dhɨr gu Malkîel ja'tkam vaak gu Malkîelitas.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' mar u'vɨ gu Aser ka't gu Sera.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Aser guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Jaseel ja'tkam vaak gu Jaseelitas; mi' dhɨr gu Guni ja'tkam vaak gu Gunitas.
Jano' ba' gu Jeser ja'tkam vaak gu Jeseritas; gio ba' gu Sillem ja'tkam vaak gu Sillemitas.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Neptalii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oo'm jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maa'n jix gɨ' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix ali'; gio ba' maa'n gu maa'nkar jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bopxi'ñ tattat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix gɨ' jix ali'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Lebitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Gersoon ja'tkam vaak gu Gersonitas; mi' dhɨr gu Koat ja'tkam vaak gu Koatitas; jano' ba' gu Merari ja'tkam vaak gu Meraritas.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Lebitas; gio ba' ja'tkam vaak gu Libnitas ja'tkam vaak gu ebronitas ja'tkam vaak gu Maalitas ja'tkam vaak gu Musitas ja'tkam vaak gu Koritas; mi' dhɨr gu Koat jix mar gu Amram.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Amram jup tɨɨt gu Jokâbed mar u'vɨ gu Lebii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Lebii gu Ejipto; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Amram gu Aaroon gu Moisees gu Mariia gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu Nadab gu Abiuu jix koko' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu tai guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Lebitas jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jiix; na gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.

Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ koi oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun.

Jano' ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Salpaad gu mar gu eper gu mar gu Galaad gu mar gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Manasees gu mar gu Josee guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Maala gu Noa gu ogla gu Milka gu Tirsa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan gu Moisees vupui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar vupui bhaan chiñia' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gui'p.

Jano' ba' chulhiiñdha' gu taat jix koi oidha' jix gaki cham juruuñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jum daa'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chu'p gu Koree; gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat uañi'ñ jix koi cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' chulhiiñdha' gu taat tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu mar gu Danos gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam chulhiiñdha' gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kuiñcha vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Salpaad; gio ba' jix duu gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu taat; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu maa'nkar gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook bham; na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' vaak jodai cham gu ma'nkam bhaan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mar u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' cham palhɨɨp mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' cham palhɨɨp gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam gu taat.

Jano' ba' tu' gu taat cham palhɨɨp gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jir bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mia'n gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' ka't gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook kavɨk jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' bhɨɨk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu u'vɨ gu Madianitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaakax bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx gu tai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh taañpu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax.

Jano' ba' aichdhak gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat yooxi' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' moor gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx chiñia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix duu mai' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' bhaam gu Moisees bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Balaam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Peor; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jano' bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ a'aalh; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gio bɨx gu u'vɨ ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mai' yooxi' kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga no'x bhɨɨya' dhaa jix koi guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vaik kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx tɨi'chu' bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨɨt bɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios chiiw bɨx vaaso gu u'u.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham aajidha' bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' dhi' jir bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kavɨk jodai dhi' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tai guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't na jix bhai' xoi'kam gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu; gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' bɨx cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tai.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jajannulhi'ñ kɨɨv gu tanoolh boopoya' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' mi' dhɨr ba'k yooxi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p gu vaakax tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar ɨɨbhidham tattat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga moor bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' gu Jawatan Dios namki'ñdha' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham moor bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p gu vaakax buur kakneer.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' maa'n gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn maa'n mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaakax buur kakneer bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' maa'n gu Lebitas namki' jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' kakneer.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' buur.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu u'vɨ cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' vaik guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kakneer.
Jano' ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios kakneer ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ'; gio ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook.
Jano' ba' buur guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'n.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ'; gio ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu Moisees namki'ñdha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix ai'chdhix gu Moisees gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't; gio ba' kakneer vaik guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Jano' ba' buur guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ'; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees maa'n mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p gu vaakax jix maa gu Lebitas ko'kmarak jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu mii' dhɨr ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu Moisees; gio ba' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios no'ch.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar maa'n tu' gaagam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix uam jodai guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' bɨx jix uam jodai gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios maa'n na ba'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Moisees jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar jix uam jodai bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios aichdhak vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chɨ'ñchoka' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaakax; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jaser gu Galaad guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios pai' gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen tu ñi'ook gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan chiñia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham.
Jano' ba' gu Atarot gu Diboon gu Jaser gu Nimra gu esboon gu Eleale gu Sabaan gu Nebo gu Beoon.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n vupui bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel gu oidha' gu vaakax tu duukam namki' gu vaakax.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gui'p tu' bakia' nɨidhidha' gu vupui guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' gu oidha' tu duukam gu maa'nkar cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen; gio ba' aajim gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' tu' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duu tattat na pai' dhuuk tu jiim dɨr gu Kades-barnea na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha'.

Na guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Eskol mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa.
Jano' ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bham.

Na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Ejipto guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob na gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Keneseo gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu i'iich gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx mii' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' dhi' gu oidha' ka't pai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu kavɨk gu or nɨi'ñchudat ba'k gu amat ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu Sedad.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' tas buusñi nɨi'ñchudat dɨr gu asar-enaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Sepam.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios koi guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gui'x pai' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mua'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ oi'ñdha' koi'm guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gui'x guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jir bɨx bhai' jix koi jurtu'nka' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' jix koi bakia' mai' gu oidha' kiicham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jir bɨx bhai' jix koi mua'kam kooda' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na gu' kiicham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' mi' dhɨr vaak jodai jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan mua'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu'x ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jir bɨx bhai' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' no'x guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mua'kam; gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ñi'ookdham cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam u'uuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' mua'kam; na gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ koi'm; gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam u'uuk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kiicham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga duaka' gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu oidha' pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na gu' dhi' gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr pai' cham ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ɨ'ɨr ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ɨ'ɨr ja'aa.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu oidha' pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam chiñia' tattat ja'tkam vaak gu Galaad gu mar gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Moisees chiñia' ɨɨbhidham tattat gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam koi gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr gio tu' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan jix maa gu maa'nkar gu Salpaad chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx dhɨt gu ma'nkam bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bopxi'ñ ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu maa'nkar.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk daraibu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ bɨpna'; gio ba' gu maa'nkar ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'ñdhix gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Josee tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' dhi' tu' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Salpaad bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu taat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Na ba' na ba' gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham ka't bhaan bopxi'ñ; na gu' maa'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ tattat.

Jano' ba' no'x mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx oi'ñdha' ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu taat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'n gu maa'nkar tattat.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bopxi'ñ; gu' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees jix duu ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Salpaad.
Jano' ba' gu Maala gu Tirsa gu ogla gu Milkâ gu Noa ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Salpaad guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu mar gu Josee jix bɨɨx duu gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bopxi'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
